title: Junior Estimator / Estimator - Civil, Paving & Concrete
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as an Estimator?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have Concrete Construction experience?
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (advert 95169325, four screening questions). No link out; the employer's site lists only a sales inbox, not an applications address.
rationale: Junior estimator role that accepts a civil engineering qualification and offers mentoring from the General Manager; Marc holds a BSCE and an Advanced Diploma.
Duties (quantity take-offs for pavement, kerbs and concrete slabs from civil drawings, cost breakdowns) connect to his coursework cost estimates and bills of quantities and his pavement design study.
Site work in the Philippines tracking procurement and material records is relevant to supplier pricing and material lists.
caution: Estimating, not drafting or site coordination; Marc's estimating is coursework only and he has not used take-off software. Sydney based while Marc lives in Melton, so it needs relocation. Concrete construction experience is not on record.
gaps: No take-off or estimating software (Bluebeam, Benchmark) used
employer_line: Civilworks Australia Group is a Padstow based paving and concrete subcontractor installing council-approved granite and porcelain pavers, and the concrete beneath them, for footpaths, driveways and public domain areas across Sydney.
